jobs.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Cartographer's Table game UI concept, English only. Preserve the warm parchment, miniature battlefield, top resource bar, one shallow DPS strip, map, approved icon conventions, five recruit cards and one-expanded-recipe rule. Mage I is selected (cyan outline), followed by Druid I, Engineer I and two unrevealed silhouettes; a selected revealed unit can be inspected before commitment. Left heading 'Building' and concise 'Place recruit 4 of 5'. Below cards retain ONE compact Future draws row: I 49%, II 34%, III 17%, IV 0%, V 0%, VI 0%. NO Keep/Reroll/Reserve buttons or unavailable placeholders. Middle detail identity 'Mage I · Candidate', damage type MAGICAL. Replace lore with concise quantified effect 'Splash: 30% · 3.6 Magical damage · radius 3 tiles'. Show I–VI compare-rank controls with I selected. Under them a 2x2 stat grid: 'Damage / hit 12', 'Base direct DPS 12', 'Range 5 tiles', 'Interval 1 s'. At right compact 'Pinned recipe' Elven Ranger, Cleric I Built / Druid I This round / Archer I Missing. Only one pinned overview, no large duplicated portrait block. Keep the SAME visual structure as Choose keeper, adapting content to phase rather than a different design.
